be_verwaltungsgericht: Direct scrape at parity since the docket-anchored parser fix of 2026-08-27: on 2026-09-15 the portal's 11,633 listing rows resolved to 11,600 distinct dockets, all held (11,618 held in total). The remaining listing difference is duplicate or under-filled rows of the date-windowed listing.
vs_gerichte: The portal counts documents: ZWR/RVJ journal reprints and same-day re-uploads share a case number with the decision, which the corpus holds once; since 2026-09-15 the gap metric counts distinct case numbers. About 4-5 second rulings filed under an already-held case number (district court and Kantonsgericht) are not in the corpus yet (identity decision pending).
bs_appellationsgericht: Verified complete 2026-09-15: every case year 2013-2026 was enumerated and 7,691 of 7,695 listed decisions were held (the other 4 were published that day), including the bulk publication of 11.12.2018 for case years 2014-2017 (2,552 decisions, all held). The portal returns at most 500 rows per query, so the nightly log warns for case years above 500; nothing is missing.
bl_gerichte: The Kantonsgericht published ~4,997 decisions on a portal that went offline; 903 recovered via the Internet Archive (2026-04). Outreach to the court pending since 2026-04-17; remainder is a known upstream-availability gap, not a scrape failure.
bger: Complete for published decisions from 2000 (verified against citation-gap oracles). Pre-2000 ordinary judgments were never put online by the court. Pre-2007 EVG social-insurance decisions (~15,215) are recoverable and queued.
bge: Official collection complete (verified 0 missing vs external benchmark). Volume citations before 1954 partially carry publication-year dating semantics.
ow_gerichte: The portal is online but frozen: it lists the same 2,205 decisions every night, newest upload 2022-12-19. A successor portal appeared in 2026 and is re-probed weekly; intake resumes if it yields decisions.
ge_gerichte: 7,051 decisions (ATAS/ACJC 2006-2013) had unreadable CID-font PDF text; recovered via OCR on 2026-07-01 and fully searchable since 2026-07-02. Docket field carries bare cause numbers for some older rows.
ch_vb: Frozen archive (source ceased publishing in 2021); preserved via the entscheidsuche archive, no new intake by design.
be_steuerrekurs: Portal's backing database returns zero rows for all queries since Feb 2026 (verified against the live GWT protocol); 343 historical decisions preserved. Re-probed weekly.
mkg: Complete archival corpus of the Militärkassationsgericht, volumes 1-16 (1915-2025); the court publishes no new volumes.
sg_publikationen: Publication practice example: St. Gallen published 5 of 272 employment rulings 2002-2017. Low counts here reflect court publication policy, not capture failure.
ti_gerichte: ~549 rows carry no machine-readable date (PDFs truncated upstream). Text completeness restored 2026-06-29 (control-character stripping). Since 2026-09-15 new rows take their decision date from the result table; older undated rows await a backfill.
fr_anwaltsaufsicht: Registered source; the authority has published zero decisions to date (0 by design, not a failure).
vd_findinfo: Frozen entscheidsuche-sourced archive of the pre-2015 FindInfo portal; new VD decisions arrive via the direct vd_gerichte scraper.
